title: Chatticus README tree says web/ is marketing; marketing moved to the Chattic.us-web repo
description:
**Problem**
The README repository tree describes web/ as marketing, but the marketing site is now the private Chattic.us-web repo (the README itself says so elsewhere).

**Evidence**
README.md:234 "web/ Marketing (`/`) and product workspace (`/chat`)"; README.md:10 and :80 say the marketing site is a separate private repo.

**Fix**
Update the tree line to describe web/ as the product workspace only.

**How to verify**
`grep -n 'Marketing (' README.md` returns nothing, and the README no longer places marketing in this repo.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
